name: bars-equalizer
prompt: Extension layer type: fake audio equalizer bars. Bar count and speed parameters, a toggle for mirrored bars.

provenance.via: claude --print with the in-app agent instructions (no Powermove MCP tools)

summary: I wrote `gen.eq-bars`, a fragment layer that draws fake equalizer bars. Bar Count, Speed and Mirrored are the main controls, with Gap, Base Color and Peak Color under More. None of it was compiled or rendered because no live Powermove tools were attached. I assumed `iTime` and `uv` are available as in shader layers, with uv.y = 0 at the top.
